Arrokuda

Water

Galar · Generation 8

Arrokuda is a Water-type Rush Pokémon first found in Galar (Generation 8). It stands 0.5 m tall and weighs 1 kg. It evolves into Barraskewda. Its highest base stat is Speed (66), with a base stat total of 280.
